MATCH (a:Issue)-[r]->(b:Issue) WHERE r.linkId IS NOT NULL
MATCH (a)-[:IN_PROJECT]->(p:Project), (b)-[:IN_PROJECT]->(q:Project) WHERE p<>q
WITH p.projectKey AS pk, a.issueKey AS ak, b.issueKey AS bk, r.linkId AS l
RETURN pk, count(DISTINCT ak) AS c

MATCH (a:Issue)-[r]->(b:Issue) WHERE r.linkId IS NOT NULL
MATCH (a)-[:IN_PROJECT]->(p:Project), (b)-[:IN_PROJECT]->(q:Project) WHERE p<>q
UNWIND [[a.issueKey,p.projectKey],[b.issueKey,q.projectKey]] AS x
WITH x[1] AS id, count(DISTINCT x[0]) AS value
ORDER BY value DESC
RETURN id, value

MATCH (a:Issue)-[r]->(b:Issue) WHERE r.linkId IS NOT NULL
MATCH (a)-[:IN_PROJECT]->(p:Project), (b)-[:IN_PROJECT]->(q:Project) WHERE p<>q
UNWIND [[a.issueKey,p.projectKey],[b.issueKey,q.projectKey]] AS x
WITH x[1] AS id, count(DISTINCT x[0]) AS value
ORDER BY value DESC LIMIT 5
RETURN id, value

MATCH (a:Issue)-[r]->(b:Issue) WHERE r.linkId IS NOT NULL
MATCH (a)-[:IN_PROJECT]->(p:Project), (b)-[:IN_PROJECT]->(q:Project) WHERE p<>q AND (p.projectKey IN ['FE','CRUC','JRASERVER','CWD','BAM'] OR q.projectKey IN ['FE','CRUC','JRASERVER','CWD','BAM'])
UNWIND [a.issueKey,b.issueKey] AS ik
RETURN DISTINCT ik AS issue, r.linkId AS link
